intro: ClickFix leads coverage across 65 social-engineering articles published between 2026-04-08 and 2026-10-22, with Lazarus Group and UNC6692 also tracked. Reporting references CVE-2023-36036, CVE-2025-24054, CVE-2025-33053, and CVE-2026-21513. Financial services, cryptocurrency, technology, financial-services, and government appear among the affected sectors. Coverage spans Global, North america, United states, Europe, and United kingdom. The severity mix comprises 49 high, 2 informational, 11 medium, and 1 critical. ClickFix, Lazarus Group, and UNC6692 are listed as distinct threat actors in the archive.
